validation: Migration, bounded restricted paid analysis, canonical cold backup/restore,20 independent browser observations and scoped cleanup passed

ownership.ports: Three distinct OS-selected loopback ports, recorded in private.json and printed as public UI URLs; no use or stop of4494 or4496
ownership.clickhouse: One new source container, stopped before one new restore container is started; source data and Keeper stay within task Compose volume
ownership.gateway: One separate native process from current host checkout, with generated master/signing/service/UI credentials and task config. PID command line ownership checked before termination
ownership.shared_database_write: Only a newly generated unique analysis virtual key and its paid request accounting in the existing local task gateway database; cleanup revokes that key. No existing records/config are edited
ownership.source_guards: Image ID exact; migrate,trace-storage,Compose and Keeper trees must match runtime105; current host SHA recorded; target path and Compose-name prefix checked before nonprepare phases
ownership.unrelated_gateway_database: Read-only psql compares base-table schema count/hash from PostgreSQL catalog and LiteLLM_TeamTable count/stable identity+model configuration hash before import, after import and after restore. Raw rows/credentials are excluded. Unique key and spend records are excluded
ownership.pid_guard: ps command line must contain exact unique gateway.json and port before process-group termination; absent process is treated as stopped

phase_boundaries.prepare: Copy canonical installation assets, create private task credentials, start CH and temporary PG, seed canonical trace schema with2spans+feedback and all8legacy metadata shapes. Backup source PG SQL and cold CH directory. Run plan/apply/repeat/readback via actual image importer. Stop PG before starting Lens. Start isolated gateway, create one-model/$1/1h key, reject old stored hash and denied model. API comparisons preserve investigation/finding/alias/history, dataset revisions1/2/export, trace/feedback and imported ingestion receipt
phase_boundaries.analyze: One manual investigation over the migrated2span trace, maximum15minute poll. Requires completed paid result, actual restricted-key spend equal to job cost and Lens spend delta, no active reservations. No automatic retry of a failed paid run
phase_boundaries.backup: Requires successful bounded analysis. Uses the canonical backup helper; verifies current API readback. Writes a post-backup dataset sentinel
phase_boundaries.restore: Stop only task source services/gateway. Canonical restore helper creates fresh project/volume from cold backup. Restart only task gateway pointing to restored Lens. Compare both API views, historic/current dataset exports, imported trace/key, feedback and session; post-backup sentinel must be absent; PG remains stopped; completed paid job full-body digest and investigation spend must exactly match pre-backup values
phase_boundaries.cleanup: Revoke only generated analysis key, verify task process ownership then terminate it, remove only2task Compose projects/volumes and temporary PG. Private artifacts/backups remain for deliberate deletion after safe receipts are copied

browser_pauses.action: Open both printed UI URLs through the normal login flow. Standalone admin is in private.json; embedded login uses migration-admin and private uiPassword. Inspect migration-proof trace in Thread and Steps, preserved feedback, Migrated order cases revision1and2, Preserved finding and migrated-archive. Reload saved links. Capture standalone+embedded screenshots and visible content comparisons
Open Migrated invoice investigation, inspect completed new run, evidence citations, model and recorded cost in both shells. Capture screenshots

Open restored standalone URL and unchanged task gateway URL, inspect prior investigation, historical dataset/export and trace. Confirm source PG is stopped from proof, and record final screenshots. Only then append a separate browser receipt with actual observations

receipt_policy: proof.json contains no credentials; private.json, .env, gateway.json, command logs and backups stay private. Script leaves browser evidence pending; do not claim full migration acceptance before manual captures and reviewer reconciliation
limits: Local synthetic migration qualified; official artifact and managed production gates remain separate
Uses synthetic internal representative data rather than a customer database dump
Current host source/static UI are consumed; production gateway image and actual chart cutover remain storage-lane boundaries
Reuses existing local task gateway database for the uniquely generated key; no new full gateway database needed
M7 is the HTTP lane and intentionally not duplicated
Cold backup elapsed time and restored elapsed time are local operation measurements, not measured end-user outage of an actual prior deployment
Pre-migration rollback is represented by untouched PostgreSQL plus source dumps; the executed recovery path is post-write forward restore to the new Lens image

prepare_execution.script_note: Only subsequent harness change saves generated restricted key immediately, before further assertions, so failed setup can revoke it

harness_changes: After successful prepare, save generated analysis credential immediately for reliable failure cleanup; no effect on successful execution
After successful analysis, strengthen backup/restore to compare full completed-job digest and investigation spend; no product change
